'''Velser's Ring''', '''Velsor's Ring''', or '''Velser's Rim''', was an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Bespin system/Legends|Bespin system]] named after the [[Velser/Legends|leader]] of the survey team that discovered it.

It was the remains of an unstable [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] in the [[Star system/Legends|system's]] third [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]]. Composed of refractive frozen gases and liquids, it appeared as a giant rainbow in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] when viewed from certain angles.

[[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] were sent to collect the frozen gases, which were used in the production of [[Laser/Legends|lasers]], [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-freezing]] units and [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] helix tubes used on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].
